whoItsFor: Developers and automation engineers who need a Playwright or Puppeteer browser that gets past anti-bot checks such as Cloudflare Turnstile, reCAPTCHA v3, and FingerprintJS. It is aimed at scraping, QA, and monitoring work against protected sites.
useCases: Scraping sites protected by Cloudflare Turnstile or similar bot checks
Running browser automation that must pass reCAPTCHA v3 or fingerprint-based detection
Drop-in stealth browser for AI agents and existing Playwright or Puppeteer scripts

requirements.os: Linux x64, Linux ARM64, Windows x64, macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)
requirements.runtime: Python or Node.js (pip install cloakbrowser / npm install cloakbrowser); Docker optional
